example_prompt: Add a NimbaSMS delivery status webhook to track message delivery in my app.

messageid.description: Identifier of the message whose status changed. Matches the messageid returned by send_message.

status.description: New message status. 'received' = delivered to the recipient, 'failed' = delivery failure.

contact.description: Phone number of the recipient concerned.

message_type.description: Message type. Always 'API' for messages sent via the API.

status.description: Your server must return HTTP 200 with this field to confirm receipt.

gotchas: Your server must return HTTP 200 immediately upon receipt — NimbaSMS resends the notification up to 3 times if the response is not 200. Any heavy processing must be asynchronous.
The webhook is configured in the NimbaSMS dashboard (API KEYS > Webhooks), not via the API. Only one webhook URL per account.
Notifications are only available for messages sent via the API (metadata.message_type: 'API').
NimbaSMS does not sign incoming requests — validate that messageid actually exists in your system before processing the notification, to guard against fraudulent requests.
The webhook receives one event per recipient ('contact' field) — a message sent to 10 recipients can trigger up to 10 separate webhook calls.
